reason: Each child (ten powers, fearlessnesses, mindfulnesses, great compassion) is a long explanation with knowledge-types, grounds, doubts and answers, and scriptural citations.
The four children are one-line definitions of each analytic knowledge; the longer discussion of grounds and acquisition under the last child concerns all four together.
The children present and refute an opposing view and then set out the own view with commentarial sources, a real argument.
The four children only list the limbs of each dhyana with their antidote/benefit/basis labels; the extended debate after the fourth concerns the limbs in general.
Each child explains at length how the pure, undefiled and afflicted absorptions are obtained, with distinctions and a treatise citation.
The children describe the preparatory and actual practice of the skipping absorption in detailed procedural explanation.
Each child (immeasurables, liberations, overpowerings, totalities) gives an extended explanation with nature, ground, object, doubts and differing views.
The children explain the teaching and its holders, defend the author against faults, and admonish successors at length with history and verses.
